answer: By introducing quadratic staking erosion, the protocol effectively exploits the diminishing returns of Sybil clusters, rendering marginal attack costs super-linear, thus exceeding any potential extracted value. As the dawn of a new epoch approaches, the echo of previous attacks fades, but the quill of slashing penalties remains, etching a permanent record of costly misbehavior, guaranteeing that the expected utility of an attack is negative and discouraging would-be Sybil attackers.
